description: A helper class for extracting and parsing JSON attribute values, including handling of locale-specific number and date formats, within the Fineract project.

classes.name: JsonParserHelper
classes.description: A utility class for extracting and converting JSON attribute values, including handling of locale-specific formats and date/time parsing.

methods.name: parameterExists
methods.description: Checks if a parameter exists within a JSON element.

methods.name: parameterHasValue
methods.description: Checks if a parameter has a non-blank value within a JSON object.
